name: El Chaltén
tagline: Argentina's trekking capital under Mount Fitz Roy
summary: El Chaltén is a small mountain village built for hikers, at the foot of the jagged Fitz Roy massif. Hike to Laguna de los Tres for sunrise on Fitz Roy, walk to Laguna Torre beneath Cerro Torre, and enjoy craft beer in town after long, free trails in Los Glaciares National Park.
seasonNote: November to March; many places close in winter. Patagonian winds are strong.
arrival: About 3 hours by bus from El Calafate.
gettingAround: Trails start in the village; shuttles to some trailheads.
cashTip: Carry pesos; cards often get a better rate now. ATMs can run out in El Chaltén, so bring cash.
foodTip: Patagonian lamb, craft beer and empanadas.
